data.title: Joe Louis Theatre launches book on 125 years of Thai puppetry on Sept 24
data.description: Copies of a new Thai puppetry book are going to libraries, with an English edition planned and interactive upgrades for the completed e-book.

data.title: COP31 eyes modest steps as climate disasters multiply
data.description: PARIS - Nations reeling from a year of climate devastation gather for COP31 next month but negotiations are not expected to deliver major progress in cutting the fossil fuels driving the crisis.

data.title: IRPC joins force with PTT to provide flood relief supports
data.description: IRPC Public Company Limited (IRPC) led by Sirimeth Leepagorn, Chief Executive Officer and President, in collaboration with PTT Group, handed over relief assistance through the Ministry of Energy to alleviate the suffering of flood victims. The donation was received by Akanat Promphan, Minister of Energy; Chantanon Wannakejohn, Permanent Secretary for Energy; and Sarawut Kaewtathip, Director-General of the Department of Energy Business.

data.title: Tens of thousands expected in Paris for high school protests
data.description: PARIS — Tens of thousands of demonstrators are expected on the streets of Paris on Tuesday as France's powerful trade unions join high school students rallying for better conditions in a wave of protests marked by clashes with police.

data.title: American Nobel laureate in medicine hopes to illuminate the brain
data.description: WASHINGTON - Nobel Prize-winning American researcher Karl Deisseroth is a psychiatrist, neuroscientist and bioengineer who has spent more than two decades illuminating the workings of the brain to unlock its mysteries.

data.title: NHL record-breaker Ovechkin says current season will be his last
data.description: WASHINGTON — NHL all-time scoring leader Alex Ovechkin said Monday that the current season will be his last in the North American ice hockey league.

data.title: Islamic finance forum to chart course towards a more sustainable future
data.description: Islamic finance leaders and experts from around the world to exchange perspectives on strengthening economic resilience, mobilising transition finance, and expanding opportunities for international collaboration. The international forum, “Islamic Finance: From Crisis Resilience to Transition Finance”, will be held as an Affiliated Programme in conjunction with the 2026 Annual Meetings of the International Monetary Fund (IMF) and the World Bank Group, hosted by Thailand. The event is scheduled for Wednesday, Oct 14, at the Grand Ballroom, The Westin Grande Sukhumvit, Bangkok.

data.title: Thailand says risk from suspected pneumonic plague case in Russia remains low
data.description: Thailand’s DDC says the risk of importing plague from a suspected case in Russia remains low, with no confirmed spread or need for extra border screening.

data.title: Sea and OpenAI Bring Regional Codex Hackathon Series to Thailand
data.description: Bangkok - Global technology company Sea and OpenAI are bringing the Sea x OpenAI Regional Codex Hackathon Series to Thailand, with the one-day hackathon taking place in Bangkok on 21 November 2026.

data.title: France roar back in Nations League as Italy beat Turkey
data.description: PARIS - Michael Olise starred as France stormed back from behind to thrash Belgium 4-1 in the Uefa Nations League on Monday, while Italy continued their resurgence with victory over Turkey.

data.title: Trump approves firing squad for convicted US military base shooter
data.description: WASHINGTON (UNITED STATES) - President Donald Trump has approved the execution by firing squad of Nidal Hasan, a US Army psychiatrist who shot dead 13 people at a military base in 2009, the Pentagon said on Monday.

data.title: Grappling with 'homework scams,' US universities shun AI detectors
data.description: WASHINGTON (UNITED STATES) - Locked in a cat-and-mouse struggle, biology professor Timothy Paustian devised novel ways to catch students turning in chatbot-generated assignments. But like many US universities, his institution is shunning AI detection software.

data.title: Thai Galleries Association stages  new international art fair in Paragon
data.description: The Thai Galleries Association is holding "Art Bangkok 2026 - The First Chapter", a new international art fair to connect Thailand's art scene with the international art world. It will kick off tomorrow and run daily from noon to 7pm until Sunday at NEX Hall and Jewel Zone, 5th floor of Siam Paragon, Rama I Road.

data.title: Gaysorn Amarin showcases prize  watches ahead of Geneva show
data.description: Bangkok has been selected as one of only four global destinations to host the Grand Prix d'Horlogerie de Genève (GPHG) Nomination Tour 2026, at The Forum of Gaysorn Amarin, Phloenchit Road, from Oct 15-18.

data.title: Guru's daily horoscope for Oct 6
data.description: The day of the week you were born on can reveal a lot... Read on.

data.title: Easy! Buddy brings the 'Taste Of Macao'
data.description: Easy! Buddy, a Thai casual-dining restaurant, is serving three exclusive dishes that reimagine authentic Macanese culinary heritage and, possibly, inspire diners to travel to Macao, at all branches until Nov 7.

data.title: Russia downplays plague reports as Trump offers US help
data.description: MOSCOW - Russia on Monday sought to downplay reports that a laboratory technician had died of plague, even as President Donald Trump said Washington was closely monitoring the situation and offered US help.

data.title: Passion in motion
data.description: Two years after its debut, Hong Kong Performing Arts Expo (HKPAX) 2026 returns with the theme "Passion In Motion".

data.title: Best-selling British author Jeffrey Archer dies aged 86
data.description: LONDON - British author Jeffrey Archer, who penned a series of best-selling novels, served as a Conservative MP and was convicted of perjury, died suddenly at 86, his publisher HarperCollins said.

data.title: Rungroj to spearhead Thai charge
data.description: The man who gave Thailand its first Paralympic table tennis gold is hungry for more.

data.title: Piyabutr warns of 'entertainocracy'
data.description: Progressive Movement secretary-general Piyabutr Saengkanokkul has warned that popular politicians can become too powerful for their parties to control, allowing personality-driven politics to eclipse ideology.

data.title: PM orders flood aid sped up
data.description: Prime Minister Anutin Charnvirakul has ordered authorities to ensure the first batch of flood relief payments reaches affected households this week, with verified claims to be paid without waiting for nationwide processing to finish.

data.title: Shaanxi to Siam: A Silk Road story
data.description: 'It tells you what you need to know about China," joked Italian photographer-blogger Fabio Nodari as we peered at the inscription on an intricately designed wine vessel at the Baoji Bronze Ware Museum in Shaanxi province, land of the Terracotta Warriors.

data.title: Bank staff alert leads police to nab two scam suspects
data.description: A bank worker's alert helped police arrest two men allegedly linked to a scam after a 19-year-old university student tried to withdraw 2.5 million baht, police said on Monday.

data.title: Saleumxay elected PM
data.description: Saleumxay Kommasith, the former standing deputy prime minister, was elected prime minister of Laos yesterday by the Second Ordinary Session of the National Assembly's 10th Legislature.

data.title: Govt seeks unified flood response
data.description: The government on Monday ordered a review of its flood-risk map and called on all agencies to use a single data set to manage water.

data.title: Govt denies Thai PBS takeover
data.description: The government has rejected claims that proposed changes to the "sin tax" funding system would allow Bhumjaithai MPs to take control of Thai PBS, saying the broadcaster's management structure would remain unchanged.

data.title: PM rules out healthcare benefit cuts
data.description: Prime Minister Anutin Charnvirakul on Monday assured protesters that universal healthcare benefits would not be cut as he received a petition calling for stronger housing rights and solutions to land disputes on World Habitat Day.

data.title: Dams 'ready' for more water
data.description: The Royal Irrigation Department (RID) said on Monday that the country's two major northern dams still had room to absorb more water and that a large discharge from the Chao Phraya dam had already passed Bangkok without causing flooding.

data.title: Expert urges govt to look into tobacco  tax reform
data.description: A Mahidol University academic has called for an investigation into Thailand's 2017 tobacco tax reform, which she estimates has cost the government about 20 billion baht a year in lost revenue.

data.title: Oil slick prompts health warnings
data.description: PRACHIN BURI: Highly toxic industrial runoff is suspected to have mixed with widespread stagnant floodwaters here, prompting health warnings after a foul-smelling, rainbow-coloured sheen spread across flooded areas.

data.title: Nigeria's Tinubu confirms 32 dead after military plane crash
data.description: LAGOS - A Nigerian Air Force plane crashed on Monday in the country's southwestern Ondo state, killing all 32 people on board, President Bola Tinubu said.

data.title: Switching on brain cells: the Nobel-winning science of optogenetics
data.description: PARIS (FRANCE) - In optogenetics, scientists control neurones by stimulating them with light -- potentially unlocking breakthroughs for conditions such as dementia, depression and blindness.
